File every sentence under that heading. In the JSON, the headings are the keys subjective, objective_exam, objective_results and assessment_and_plan. Return each sentence ID under exactly one heading. Do not leave any sentence out and do not invent IDs.

S9 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: The patient requested a prescription for Vicodin and Demerol.

S11 [SUBJECTIVE]: He is currently taking ibuprofen 800 mg daily.

S13 [SUBJECTIVE]: Stretching and ibuprofen 800 mg daily are helpful, but he denies having tried icing the area.
S14 [SUBJECTIVE]: Other than spontaneous flare-ups, his pain is worsened with excessive spinal flexion.

S16 [OBJECTIVE RESULTS]: X-ray images of the lumbar spine were obtained and reviewed in office today.

S18 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: Low back pain, left side.

S20 [ASSESSMENT AND PLAN]: I recommend that we treat the patient conservatively with formal physical therapy and meloxicam.
